document_type: CooL x Phala Real-TEE Validation Certificate
disclaimer: This is a technical validation certificate produced from evidence gathered by Northwind Cipher during this validation run. It is NOT a third-party certification. Phala Network did not issue, endorse, or co-sign this document. No SOC 2, ISO, or other compliance certification is claimed.

sdk_fix_applied.description: HttpDstackClient.info() now parses tcb_info as a JSON-encoded string (the real dstack guest-agent response shape) instead of assuming it is already a nested object; previously this caused every real deployment to silently fall back to an all-zero measurement.
sdk_fix_applied.verified_not_regressed_by: Validated against real hardware; covered by dedicated regression tests in tests/real-tee-validation.test.ts (added after the audit; negative-controlled against the pre-fix code). Full suite: 97 tests, 96 pass, 0 fail, 1 network-dependent skip.

tee.measurement_note: MRTD/RTMR0-2 identical between deployment A and B (same base dstack OS image/firmware); only RTMR3 (application/compose identity) differs, matching expected TDX register semantics. Docker image digest is recorded separately and never conflated with the TDX measurement.

attestation_verification.method: Online Intel TDX quote verification through Phala Cloud's attestation service; additionally a local @phala/dcap-qvl check using archived Intel collateral (offline at verify time, collateral obtained online).
attestation_verification.verification_type: online, collateral-assisted (network call to Phala's API required — explicitly NOT claimed as offline)

key_binding.mechanism: quote report_data commits to a canonical CBOR digest of the CooL signing key's public halves (ML-DSA-65 + Ed25519); verifier recomputes and compares

seven_domain_result.inclusion: PASS (final run: leaf 5 of a size-6 tree)
seven_domain_result.consistency: PASS as a mechanism on the deployed log's enclave-signed heads (final run); NOT a receipt verdict domain; not exercised by the size-1 Run 1 receipt
seven_domain_result.witness: Cryptographically independent key demonstrated (PASS); operational third-party independence NOT demonstrated
seven_domain_result.attestation: PASS: online via Phala Cloud attestation service; local dcap-qvl check with archived collateral PASS (TCB UpToDate)
seven_domain_result.enclave: PASS: measurements match raw quote, report_data binds signing key, wrong pin fails, requireHardware fails closed
seven_domain_result.overall: 6 of 7 verified with real evidence; witness partial. NOT reported as 7/7.

tamper_test.result: verification FAILED as expected: binding, signature, and inclusion all reported fail

verifier_version_context: src/phala/verify.ts as of commit 0eaf98533a55dcea7829218f7701da48a56b8b5c, plus the dstack.ts tcb_info parsing fix described above

cost.note: Estimate from elapsed runtime x hourly rate; exact billed figure is authoritative on the Phala Cloud dashboard

limitations: GPU/confidential-GPU attestation was not tested; this validation is CPU Intel TDX only.
The witness domain's independence is cryptographically real but operationally self-administered in this test (same operator controls both keys).
Attestation verification depends on Phala Cloud's attestation API being reachable at verify time (online, not offline/air-gapped).
No SOC 2 / ISO / HIPAA / other compliance certification is claimed or implied.
This is not a claim of production readiness, a Phala partnership, or a commercial contract.
Consistency is not a receipt verdict domain.
CooL records tcb_status as 'Unknown'; TCB UpToDate was reported by the local dcap-qvl check, not by CooL.
correction_notice: This certificate was corrected after an independent audit. Earlier text reported '7/7 REAL', 'consistency PASS' and a test-suite claim for the tcb_info fix; those statements were not supported and are replaced below. See artifacts/final-verification-matrix.md.
